paragraphs: The XE D240 was a high-output diesel variant in the X760-generation XE range, using the Ingenium AJ200D 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine. It was produced from around 2015 until the diesel engine was dropped from the UK and North American markets around 2020. As a discontinued model, we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Jaguar XE D240 Engine Codes AJ200D A 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder diesel fitted to the XE D240. Known for timing chain and injector seal wear over time — see the callout above. We replace both as standard on every AJ200D rebuild, along with EGR components and gaskets where necessary. For most XE D240 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XE D240 from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
